topic: Reject all is not opt-out — CNIL fines vanityfair.fr's publisher €750k for cookies set before and after refusal (Nov 2025)

drafts.text: Log entry: CNIL fined Condé Nast's French publisher €750,000, 20 Nov 2025. vanityfair.fr set cookies before any click, kept setting them after users hit Reject All. Reject all is not opt-out — it's a UI suggestion. Better odds here: https://data-snack.com/snack/cookie-roulette #CNIL #consent
